```
        <UnreadBanner count={326} label="Unread Messages" />
        <ConversationList>
          {conversations.map(c => (
            <ConversationRow
              key={c.id}
              name={c.contactName}
              badge={c.messageCount}
              date={c.date}
              preview={c.previewText}
              unread={c.isUnread}
              hasAttachment={c.hasAttachment}
              selected={c.id === activeConversationId}
              onSelect={() => openConversation(c.id)}
            />
          ))}
        </ConversationList>
      </ConversationListPanel>

      <ManageLink />
    </InboxLeftRail>

    <EmailThreadPanel>
      <ThreadHeader>
        <ThreadTitle name={thread.contactName} />
        <MeSenderDropdown />
        <CloseButton onClick={closeThread} />
        <ThreadMoreMenu />
      </ThreadHeader>

      <MessageList>
        {thread.messages.map(msg => (
          <MessageItem key={msg.id}>
            <MessageMeta
              sender={msg.sender}
              recipientSummary={msg.recipients}
              timestamp={msg.timestamp}
              onArchive={archiveMessage}
              onEdit={editMessage}
            />
            <MessageBody html={msg.bodyHtml} />  {/* rendered HTML email */}
            <MessageActions>
              <ReplyButton />
              <ReplyAllButton />
              <ForwardButton />
            </MessageActions>
          </MessageItem>
        ))}
      </MessageList>

      <AddNoteTray>
        <NoteInput placeholder="Add Note" shortcutKey="N" />
        <CreateNoteButton disabled={!noteText} />
      </AddNoteTray>
    </EmailThreadPanel>

    <ContactSidebar contactId={thread.contactId}>
      <ContactHeader>
        <ContactAvatar initials="NT" color="amber" size={48} />
        <ContactName>{contact.name}</ContactName>
        <ContactSubtitle>No communication yet</ContactSubtitle>
      </ContactHeader>

      <ContactQuickInfo>
        <PhoneField value={contact.phone} addLabel="Add phone" />
        <EmailField value={contact.email} />
      </ContactQuickInfo>

      <SidebarSection title="Relationships" icon="relationships" collapsible defaultExpanded>
        <AddRelationshipButton />
        {relationships.length === 0 && <EmptyState text="No relationships" />}
      </SidebarSection>

      <SidebarSection title="Details" icon="list" collapsible defaultExpanded>
        <DetailField label="Stage" value={contact.stage} />
        <DetailField label="Agent" value={contact.agent} />
        <DetailField label="Lender" value={contact.lender} />
      </SidebarSection>

      <SidebarSection title="Recent Conversations" icon="conversations" collapsible defaultExpanded>
        {recentConversations.map(c => (
          <ConversationLink key={c.id} icon="email" label={c.status} href={`/inbox-new/0/conversation/${c.id}`} />
        ))}
      </SidebarSection>

      <SidebarSection title="Activity" icon="cursor" collapsible defaultExpanded>
        {/* Empty for this contact */}
      </SidebarSection>

      <SidebarSection title="AgentFire FUB Widget" icon="document" collapsible defaultExpanded={false}>
        <AgentFireWidget contactId={contact.id} />
      </SidebarSection>
    </ContactSidebar>

  </InboxLayout>

  <HelpButton />
</AppShell>
```

### Non-obvious Implementation Notes

1. **"No communication yet" vs. visible sent email:** FUB tracks "communication" separately from the raw email thread. A sent email that was auto-archived (e.g., a marketing blast) may not count as a "communication" in FUB's definition. The sidebar derives this field from a `communication_log` table, not the raw `conversations` table. The status "No communication yet" means no manual logged call, note, text, or non-automated email reply has occurred.

2. **Tracking pixel in preview text:** When outbound marketing emails contain only a tracking pixel URL and no substantive body text, the conversation list renders the raw URL as the preview snippet. The preview extractor strips HTML tags and shows the first N characters of text content — which happens to be the pixel URL (`https://ryan-realty.com?_pxl=...`). This is not a bug but an artifact of FUB email templates where the unsubscribe/pixel footer is the only text content after HTML stripping.

3. **Sent folder scope:** The URL path `/inbox-new/0/sent/32902` shows the Sent subfolder within scope `0` (My Inbox). The `0` may represent a mailbox ID or just "all" scope. The conversation list is filtered to show outbound sent emails.

4. **Avatar color generation:** Contact avatars with initials use deterministic color generation based on the contact name hash. "NT" (Nadean TaberMartinez) gets an amber/orange hue. Colors should be from a fixed palette to ensure consistency.

5. **"AgentFire FUB Widget":** This is a custom integration widget registered by AgentFire (a real estate website platform). FUB supports custom iframe widgets in the contact sidebar via their public API. When collapsed, it shows only the header row; when expanded, it loads an iframe or fetches data from the AgentFire integration endpoint. Implementation: render as a lazy-loaded collapsible `<iframe>` or REST-fetched component.

6. **"Me" sender dropdown in thread header:** Likely allows switching to another team member's view or filtering the thread to messages from a specific sender — useful when a team inbox has multiple senders in the same thread.

7. **Keyboard shortcut "N":** The "Add Note" tray shows a keyboard shortcut badge "N" inside a styled key cap element. Pressing N when the thread is open and focus is not in another input field should focus the note textarea. Implementation: global `keydown` event listener gated on `!isInputFocused`.

8. **"Select conversations" as bulk-select entry point:** Clicking this text/checkbox selects all visible conversations in the list, enabling bulk actions (bulk archive, bulk assign, bulk mark read). The bar likely transforms to show bulk action buttons when items are selected.

9. **Recent Conversations section:** All five visible items show "archived" — this is a status label for those conversations, not the text of the message. The word "archived" is styled as a hyperlink, implying each one navigates to that specific conversation thread. The icon is an envelope (email type). Other conversation types (call, SMS) would show different icons.

10. **Add Note "Create Note" button:** In q4, the button appears in a muted/disabled visual state (light cream/beige, not the primary action color), indicating it is enabled but not the primary hover state, or it is a secondary style. Pressing creates a note on the contact's activity timeline, not a reply to the email.
